genjutsu.how: Genjutsu is one shared effect: a caught target sees a client-side illusion (fake entities, a distorted screen, a wrong HUD) chosen by the technique's variant, and moves at 60% speed
genjutsu.strength: power = caster's ninjutsu pillar x (1 + 0.1 clan bonus); duration x (1 - will / (will + 40))
breaks: the target weaves Release (Ram): costs chakra equal to 10 + the illusion's rank cost / 2
the Sharingan (stage 2) breaks any it sees cast
genjutsu.needs_sight: most genjutsu need the target to see the caster (look away to avoid; blinded targets are immune)
genjutsu.ai: caught enemies attack phantoms, flee or stand; a caught boss spends its next phase transition breaking it
genjutsu.players: on the player, genjutsu is drawn as a screen effect and fake mobs; HUD text flickers; it never takes control of the camera for more than 2 s

medical.who: anyone with control 50 who trains with the medic (Beta 3); medical ninja are a role in the squad (Progression's squad roles)
medical.healing: Mystical Palm heals by control; healing a squadmate raises their bond (a shared experience)
medical.revive: downed squadmates (knocked out, never killed) can be revived by First Aid (slowly) or Resuscitation (at once)

sensing.what: Sensing shows living things through walls (the glowing effect), reveals hidden and disguised ones, and counters smoke, mist and clones
sensing.who: sensors: Yamanaka (clan), anyone trained by the sensor master; Byakugan and Inuzuka smell are clan variants
sensing.ai: enemy sensors (scout_sensor) are why stealth needs Tobari, mist or distance

fuinjutsu.what: Fuinjutsu uses sealing tags: capture, barriers, chakra seals, storage scrolls and marks
fuinjutsu.who: the fuinjutsu master and the Uzumaki (sealing costs -20% for them)
fuinjutsu.never: seals never change the map; barriers are short-lived entities
